name: Taketoyo (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Taketoyo town emblem in white: a stylised device of curved strokes and a disc, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Taketoyo, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 5 October 1974.

features.role: Taketoyo town emblem — a stylised device of curved strokes and a disc, like a stylised character
